verses.text_uthmani: هَلْ أَتَىٰ عَلَى ٱلْإِنسَـٰنِ حِينٌ مِّنَ ٱلدَّهْرِ لَمْ يَكُن شَيْـًٔا مَّذْكُورًا

trs.20: Has there [not] come upon man a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
trs.85: Was there not a period of time when man was nothing to speak of ?
trs.22: Has there not been over Man a long period of Time, when he was nothing - (not even) mentioned?
trs.203: Has there not been over man a period of time, when he was not a thing worth mentioning?

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا خَلَقْنَا ٱلْإِنسَـٰنَ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ أَمْشَاجٍ نَّبْتَلِيهِ فَجَعَلْنَـٰهُ سَمِيعًۢا بَصِيرًا

trs.20: Indeed, We created man from a sperm-drop mixture<sup foot_note=197665>1</sup> that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
trs.85: We created man from a drop of mingled fluid to put him to the test; We gave him hearing and sight;
trs.22: Verily We created Man from a drop of mingled sperm, in order to try him: So We gave him (the gifts), of Hearing and Sight.
trs.203: Verily, We have created man from Nutfah (drops) of mixed semen (sexual discharge of man and woman), in order to try him: so We made him hearer and seer.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا هَدَيْنَـٰهُ ٱلسَّبِيلَ إِمَّا شَاكِرًا وَإِمَّا كَفُورًا

trs.20: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
trs.85: We guided him to the right path, whether he was grateful or not.
trs.22: We showed him the Way: whether he be grateful or ungrateful (rests on his will).
trs.203: Verily, We showed him the way, whether he be grateful or ungrateful.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ سَلَـٰسِلَا۟ وَأَغْلَـٰلًا وَسَعِيرًا

trs.20: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
trs.85: We have prepared chains, iron collars, and blazing Fire for the disbelievers, but
trs.22: For the Rejecters we have prepared chains, yokes, and a blazing Fire.
trs.203: Verily, We have prepared for the disbelievers iron chains, iron collars, and a blazing Fire.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ ٱلْأَبْرَارَ يَشْرَبُونَ مِن كَأْسٍ كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا كَافُورًا

trs.20: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kāfūr,<sup foot_note=197666>1</sup>
trs.85: the righteous will have a drink mixed with kafur,
trs.22: As to the Righteous, they shall drink of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Kafur,-
trs.203: Verily,, the Abrâr (the pious believers of Islamic Monotheism), shall drink of a cup (of wine) mixed with (water from a spring in Paradise called) Kâfûr

verses.text_uthmani: عَيْنًا يَشْرَبُ بِهَا عِبَادُ ٱللَّهِ يُفَجِّرُونَهَا تَفْجِيرًا

trs.20: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of Allāh will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].
trs.85: a spring for God’s servants, which flows abundantly at their wish.
trs.22: A Fountain where the Devotees of Allah do drink, making it flow in unstinted abundance.
trs.203: A spring wherefrom the slaves of Allâh will drink, causing it to gush forth abundantly.

verses.text_uthmani: يُوفُونَ بِٱلنَّذْرِ وَيَخَافُونَ يَوْمًا كَانَ شَرُّهُۥ مُسْتَطِيرًا

trs.20: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
trs.85: They fulfil their vows; they fear a day of widespread woes;
trs.22: They perform (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil flies far and wide.
trs.203: They (are those who) fulfil (their) vows, and they fear a Day whose evil will be wide-spreading.

verses.text_uthmani: وَيُطْعِمُونَ ٱلطَّعَامَ عَلَىٰ حُبِّهِۦ مِسْكِينًا وَيَتِيمًا وَأَسِيرًا

trs.20: And they give food in spite of love for it<sup foot_note=197667>1</sup> to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
trs.85: they give food to the poor, the orphan, and the captive, though they love it themselves,
trs.22: And they feed, for the love of Allah, the indigent, the orphan, and the captive,-
trs.203: And they give food, inspite of their love for it (or for the love of Him), to the Miskîn<sup foot_note=155026>1</sup> (the poor), the orphan, and the captive

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّمَا نُطْعِمُكُمْ لِوَجْهِ ٱللَّهِ لَا نُرِيدُ مِنكُمْ جَزَآءً وَلَا شُكُورًا

trs.20: [Saying], "We feed you only for the face [i.e., approval] of Allāh. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
trs.85: saying, ‘We feed you for the sake of God alone: We seek neither recompense nor thanks from you.
trs.22: (Saying),"We feed you for the sake of Allah alone: no reward do we desire from you, nor thanks.
trs.203: (Saying): "We feed you seeking Allâh’s Countenance only. We wish for no reward, nor thanks from you.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَخَافُ مِن رَّبِّنَا يَوْمًا عَبُوسًا قَمْطَرِيرًا

trs.20: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful."
trs.85: We fear the Day of our Lord––a woefully grim Day.’
trs.22: "We only fear a Day of distressful Wrath from the side of our Lord."
trs.203: "Verily, We fear from our Lord a Day, hard and distressful, that will make the faces look horrible (from extreme dislike to it)."

verses.text_uthmani: فَوَقَىٰهُمُ ٱللَّهُ شَرَّ ذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمِ وَلَقَّىٰهُمْ نَضْرَةً وَسُرُورًا

trs.20: So Allāh will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
trs.85: So God will save them from the woes of that Day, give them radiance and gladness,
trs.22: But Allah will deliver them from the evil of that Day, and will shed over them a Light of Beauty and (blissful) Joy.
trs.203: So Allâh saved them from the evil of that Day, and gave them Nadrah (a light of beauty) and joy.

translation.text: and will cause them to meet

verses.text_uthmani: وَجَزَىٰهُم بِمَا صَبَرُوا۟ جَنَّةً وَحَرِيرًا

trs.20: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].
trs.85: and reward them, for their steadfastness, with a Garden and silken robes.
trs.22: And because they were patient and constant, He will reward them with a Garden and (garments of) silk.
trs.203: And their recompense shall be Paradise, and silken garments, because they were patient.

verses.text_uthmani: مُّتَّكِـِٔينَ فِيهَا عَلَى ٱلْأَرَآئِكِ ۖ لَا يَرَوْنَ فِيهَا شَمْسًا وَلَا زَمْهَرِيرًا

trs.20: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
trs.85: They will sit on couches, feeling neither scorching heat nor biting cold,
trs.22: Reclining in the (Garden) on raised thrones, they will see there neither the sun's (excessive heat) nor (the moon's) excessive cold.
trs.203: Reclining therein on raised thrones, they will see there neither the excessive heat of the sun, nor the excessive bitter cold, (as in Paradise there is no sun and no moon).

verses.text_uthmani: وَدَانِيَةً عَلَيْهِمْ ظِلَـٰلُهَا وَذُلِّلَتْ قُطُوفُهَا تَذْلِيلًا

trs.20: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.
trs.85: with shady [branches] spread above them and clusters of fruit hanging close at hand.
trs.22: And the shades of the (Garden) will come low over them, and the bunches (of fruit), there, will hang low in humility.
trs.203: And the shade thereof is close upon them, and the bunches of fruit thereof will hang low within their reach.

verses.text_uthmani: وَيُطَافُ عَلَيْهِم بِـَٔانِيَةٍ مِّن فِضَّةٍ وَأَكْوَابٍ كَانَتْ قَوَارِيرَا۠

trs.20: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],
trs.85: They will be served with silver plates
trs.22: And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and goblets of crystal,-
trs.203: And amongst them will be passed round vessels of silver and cups of crystal -

verses.text_uthmani: قَوَارِيرَا۟ مِن فِضَّةٍ قَدَّرُوهَا تَقْدِيرًا

trs.20: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.
trs.85: and gleaming silver goblets according to their fancy,
trs.22: Crystal-clear, made of silver: they will determine the measure thereof (according to their wishes).
trs.203: Crystal-clear, made of silver. They will determine the measure thereof (according to their wishes).

verses.text_uthmani: وَيُسْقَوْنَ فِيهَا كَأْسًا كَانَ مِزَاجُهَا زَنجَبِيلًا

trs.20: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
trs.85: and they will be given a drink infused with ginger
trs.22: And they will be given to drink there of a Cup (of Wine) mixed with Zanjabil,-
trs.203: And they will be given to drink there of a cup (of wine) mixed with Zanjabîl (ginger),

translation.text: And they will be given to drink

verses.text_uthmani: عَيْنًا فِيهَا تُسَمَّىٰ سَلْسَبِيلًا

trs.20: [From] a fountain within it [i.e., Paradise] named Salsabeel.
trs.85: from a spring called Salsabil.
trs.22: A fountain there, called Salsabil.
trs.203: A spring there, called Salsabîl.

verses.text_uthmani: ۞ وَيَطُوفُ عَلَيْهِمْ وِلْدَٰنٌ مُّخَلَّدُونَ إِذَا رَأَيْتَهُمْ حَسِبْتَهُمْ لُؤْلُؤًا مَّنثُورًا

trs.20: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
trs.85: Everlasting youths will attend them––if you could see them, you would think they were scattered pearls––
trs.22: And round about them will (serve) youths of perpetual (freshness): If thou seest them, thou wouldst think them scattered Pearls.
trs.203: And round about them will (serve) boys of everlasting youth. If you see them, you would think them scattered pearls.

verses.text_uthmani: وَإِذَا رَأَيْتَ ثَمَّ رَأَيْتَ نَعِيمًا وَمُلْكًا كَبِيرًا

trs.20: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
trs.85: and if you were to look around, you would see bliss and great wealth:
trs.22: And when thou lookest, it is there thou wilt see a Bliss and a Realm Magnificent.
trs.203: And when you look there (in Paradise), you will see a delight (that cannot be imagined), and a great dominion.

verses.text_uthmani: عَـٰلِيَهُمْ ثِيَابُ سُندُسٍ خُضْرٌ وَإِسْتَبْرَقٌ ۖ وَحُلُّوٓا۟ أَسَاوِرَ مِن فِضَّةٍ وَسَقَىٰهُمْ رَبُّهُمْ شَرَابًا طَهُورًا

trs.20: Upon them [i.e., the inhabitants] will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
trs.85: they will wear garments of green silk and brocade; they will be adorned with silver bracelets; their Lord will give them a pure drink.
trs.22: Upon them will be green Garments of fine silk and heavy brocade, and they will be adorned with Bracelets of silver; and their Lord will give to them to drink of a Wine Pure and Holy.
trs.203: Their garments will be of fine green silk, and gold embroidery. They will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a pure drink.

translation.text: and will give them to drink

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذَا كَانَ لَكُمْ جَزَآءً وَكَانَ سَعْيُكُم مَّشْكُورًا

trs.20: [And it will be said], "Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated."
trs.85: [It will be said], ‘This is your reward. Your endeavours are appreciated.’
trs.22: "Verily this is a Reward for you, and your Endeavour is accepted and recognised."
trs.203: (And it will be said to them): "Verily, this is a reward for you, and your endeavour has been accepted."

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّا نَحْنُ نَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ تَنزِيلًا

trs.20: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muḥammad], the Qur’ān progressively.
trs.85: We Ourself have sent down this Quran to you [Prophet] in gradual revelation.
trs.22: It is We Who have sent down the Qur'an to thee by stages.
trs.203: Verily, it is We Who have sent down the Qur’ân to you (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) by stages.

verses.text_uthmani: فَٱصْبِرْ لِحُكْمِ رَبِّكَ وَلَا تُطِعْ مِنْهُمْ ءَاثِمًا أَوْ كَفُورًا

trs.20: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
trs.85: Await your Lord’s Judgement with patience; do not yield to any of these sinners or disbelievers;
trs.22: Therefore be patient with constancy to the Command of thy Lord, and hearken not to the sinner or the ingrate among them.
trs.203: Therefore be patient (O Muhammad صلى الله عليه وسلم) with constancy to the Command of your Lord (Allâh, by doing your duty to Him and by conveying His Message to mankind), and obey neither a sinner nor a disbeliever among them.

verses.text_uthmani: وَٱذْكُرِ ٱسْمَ رَبِّكَ بُكْرَةً وَأَصِيلًا

trs.20: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
trs.85: remember the name of your Lord at dawn and in the evening;
trs.22: And celebrate the name of thy Lord morning and evening,
trs.203: And remember the Name of your Lord every morning and afternoon [i.e. offering of the Morning (Fajr), Zuhr, and ‘Asr prayers].

verses.text_uthmani: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيْلِ فَٱسْجُدْ لَهُۥ وَسَبِّحْهُ لَيْلًا طَوِيلًا

trs.20: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt [i.e., praise] Him a long [part of the] night.
trs.85: bow down before Him, and glorify Him at length by night.
trs.22: And part of the night, prostrate thyself to Him; and glorify Him a long night through.
trs.203: And during night, prostrate yourself to Him (i.e. the offering of Maghrib and ‘Ishâ’ prayers), and glorify Him a long night through (i.e. Tahajjud prayer).

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰٓؤُلَآءِ يُحِبُّونَ ٱلْعَاجِلَةَ وَيَذَرُونَ وَرَآءَهُمْ يَوْمًا ثَقِيلًا

trs.20: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them<sup foot_note=197668>1</sup> a grave Day.
trs.85: These people love the fleeting life. They put aside [all thoughts of] a Heavy Day.
trs.22: As to these, they love the fleeting life, and put away behind them a Day (that will be) hard.
trs.203: Verily, these (disbelievers) love the present life of this world, and put behind them a heavy Day (that will be hard).

verses.text_uthmani: نَّحْنُ خَلَقْنَـٰهُمْ وَشَدَدْنَآ أَسْرَهُمْ ۖ وَإِذَا شِئْنَا بَدَّلْنَآ أَمْثَـٰلَهُمْ تَبْدِيلًا

trs.20: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
trs.85: Yet We created them; We strengthened their constitution; if We please, We can replace such people completely.
trs.22: It is We Who created them, and We have made their joints strong; but, when We will, We can substitute the like of them by a complete change.
trs.203: It is We Who created them, and We have made them of strong built. And when We will, We can replace them with others like them with a complete replacement.

verses.text_uthmani: إِنَّ هَـٰذِهِۦ تَذْكِرَةٌ ۖ فَمَن شَآءَ ٱتَّخَذَ إِلَىٰ رَبِّهِۦ سَبِيلًا

trs.20: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
trs.85: This is a reminder. Let whoever wishes, take the way to his Lord.
trs.22: This is an admonition: Whosoever will, let him take a (straight) Path to his Lord.
trs.203: Verily, this (Verse of the Qur’ân) is an admonition, so whosoever wills, let him take a Path to his Lord (Allâh).

verses.text_uthmani: وَمَا تَشَآءُونَ إِلَّآ أَن يَشَآءَ ٱللَّهُ ۚ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ كَانَ عَلِيمًا حَكِيمًا

trs.20: And you do not will except that Allāh wills. Indeed, Allāh is ever Knowing and Wise.
trs.85: But you will only wish to do so if God wills- God is all knowing, all wise-
trs.22: But ye will not, except as Allah wills; for Allah is full of Knowledge and Wisdom.
trs.203: But you cannot will, unless Allâh wills. Verily, Allâh is Ever All-Knowing, All-Wise.

verses.text_uthmani: يُدْخِلُ مَن يَشَآءُ فِى رَحْمَتِهِۦ ۚ وَٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ أَعَدَّ لَهُمْ عَذَابًا أَلِيمًۢا

trs.20: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
trs.85: He admits whoever He will into His Mercy and has prepared a painful torment for the disbelievers.
trs.22: He will admit to His Mercy whom He will; But the wrong-doers,- for them has He prepared a grievous Penalty.
trs.203: He will admit to His Mercy whom He wills and as for the Zâlimûn - (polytheists, wrong-doers) He has prepared a painful torment.
